evidence.title: Ask Self, Ask Others: Relation Is All You Need

summary: Researchers unveiled a transformer‑style architecture that frames attention as relational interactions, using self‑queries and queries about other entities to capture complex dependencies. The approach, dubbed “Relation Is All You Need,” achieves state‑of‑the‑art performance on several benchmark tasks, demonstrating the power of pure relational modeling.
title: New 'Relation Is All You Need' Model Enhances AI Reasoning with Self- and Cross-Entity Queries
